_doc: Fake sample: what tests/engine_test.sh and tests/window_real.py add to the sample manifest (schemas/examples/sample-manifest.json) in their test copy: the questions of the hand step T02 (manifest field "answers", one of each kind); "titles" (manifest field "title" of some steps); "set" (more fields of the hand step: its note, and a guide with numbered lines and one line without a number).

set.note: You do this step in the browser. RADE cannot do it for you.
guide: 2. Choose the file on the clipboard.
RADE cannot see the import page, so it asks you to confirm.

answers.prompt: How many flows does the import page show?
Anything else to report? Do not type names or addresses.
